description: This file defines the interface for handling mailmap functionality in a Git-related project. It declares external variables, macros, and function prototypes for reading and managing mailmap data, as well as mapping user information based on mailmap data.

methods.name: read_mailmap_file
methods.description: Reads mailmap data from a specified file, with options controlled by flags.

methods.name: read_mailmap_blob
methods.description: Reads mailmap data from a blob/embedded string representation.

methods.name: map_user
methods.description: Maps user details (email and name) using the mailmap data.
